reviews.text: According to the description and Early Access note: Renderise has informed the players about this planet being hostile and thus shall be receiving feedback once the updating cycles are complete.
Hints at a visually rich, sci-fi survival epic. Its industrial machinery and massive, sand-swept world set the stage for exploration. The atmosphere is intense and the potential is huge.
Ran well on LOW (30-45 FPS) on Steam Deck LCD. I suggest lowering resolution to 720p. Commands were well mapped and battery lasts 2 hours max. Recommended!
This game is made by a Russian developer. Buying it may support Russia’s war effort financially (taxes, donations) or ideologically (spreading propaganda, normalizing aggression, amplifying hate).
Type: Sci-Fi FPS Roguelite Players: 1-4 Goal: Destroy the Titan robots. Battle cyborgs and giant mechs on a desert planet. Use class skills and destructible environments to survive.
